name: Triggered design fails when selection rationale is missing

user_tasks: Account owner saves notification preferences through Settings and returns to their workspace.
key_states: Loading while fetching preferences; editable; saving; saved; error with preserved input and retry.
reuse_constraints: Keep the current frontend stack, Form component and spacing/color tokens.
decision.ui_assets: Existing settings design-system revision 4; no separate pixel mockup needed for unchanged layout.

criteria: AC1: save completes and confirms; AC2: failure preserves input and exposes retry.
acceptance.method: Browser interaction tests and manual comparison to settings revision 4.
acceptance.responsive: Check at 360px and 1280px with no clipped actions.
acceptance.keyboard_accessibility: Tab reaches fields and Save; error is announced and focus stays usable.
